Random numbers

Use rand(T) for a uniform sample on the unit interval and rand(T, n) for a vector of samples. The complex sampler draws the real and imaginary parts separately.

For real DoubleFloats, randn(T) draws a standard normal sample. randpm(T) applies a random sign to a uniform sample. For complex values, randpm applies signs to the two components independently.

using DoubleFloats, Random

rng = MersenneTwister(42)
uniform = rand(rng, Double64, 4)
normal = randn(rng, Double64)
signed = randpm(rng, ComplexDF64, 4)

@assert length(uniform) == length(signed) == 4
@assert normal isa Double64
nothing

An explicit RNG makes the example independent of the session's default generator. For randpm, the explicit RNG methods accept MersenneTwister.
